raw_text: At the Ramgarh field in Rajasthan, a khalasi was moving a length of casing when he tripped over the edge of a pipe rack and fell to the ground. He suffered soreness and pain in his left hip.
osha_event_title: Fall on same level due to tripping over an object
osha_narrative: An employee tripped on the edge of a pallet and fell to the floor, suffering an injury to the left hip.

raw_text: On 29 August 2018, a rig-in-charge was leaving the camp changing room after removing his work uniform at the Moran field. While bending to pick up the uniform that had slipped to the floor, he tripped over it and fell on the same level, sustaining a fracture of his left hip.
osha_event_title: Fall on same level due to tripping over an object
osha_narrative: On August 29, 2018, an employee was exiting a locker room stall after changing out of her uniform. As she was exiting, she dropped her uniform. When attempting to pick it up, she tripped over it and fell to the ground, fracturing her left hip.

raw_text: On a routine maintenance shift at the Duliajan oilfield, a fitter was operating a hydraulic pipe-cutter on a tubing joint. The cutter engaged unexpectedly and caused a partial amputation of the middle and ring fingers on his right hand.
osha_event_title: Contact with objects and equipment, unspecified
osha_narrative: While working on a cross cutter machine, the employee sustained a partial amputation on the middle and ring fingers of his right hand.

raw_text: 27 Mar 2021 - Naharkatiya site: while walking over the mud island near the pump house she sliped on dry leaves and fell. Usne kaha tha 'dhyan se chal', lekin foot slip ho gaya and she fractured her right ankle which required surgery. She was taken to the field clinic.
osha_event_title: Fall on same level due to slipping
osha_narrative: On March 27, 2021, an employee was walking over an island in a parking lot when she slipped on leaves on the ground and fell. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured right ankle that required surgery.

precursor_activity.text: walking over the mud island near the pump house

raw_text: Rigger Ramesh was on a hot Baghjan midday shift cleaning the mud pit when the temprature rose above 45C. He started feeling dizzy and nauseous, so his colleague shouted, bhai bahut garmi hai, paani le le, but Ramesh kept working on the pump. By the end of the WD he was unable to stand and was taken to the field clinic for heat exhaustion.
osha_nature_title: Effects of heat and light, unspecified
osha_narrative: An employee became overheated while working in a parking garage as a venue usher. The employee was admitted for heat exhaustion or heat stroke.

raw_text: On 28 June 2016 at approximately 20:45, a rigger was operating a cable winch at the Duliajan work site. His right forearm struck the shackle wheel guide bar of the equipment, resulting in a puncture wound.
osha_event_title: Caught in running equipment or machinery during regular operation
osha_narrative: On June 28, 2016, at approximately 8:45 PM, an employee was operating a machine when his arm contacted the shackle wheel guide bar on the equipment, puncturing his right forearm.

raw_text: At the Naharkatiya oilfield in Assam, a fitter was aligning 200-pound pipe racks on the production line. His little finger was crushed between two of the racks, causing an amputation.
osha_event_title: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment
osha_narrative: An employee was lining up 200-pound racks on a production line. His little finger was crushed between two of the racks, resulting in an amputation.

precursor_activity.text: aligning 200-pound pipe racks on the production line

raw_text: At the Tanot field in Rajasthan, a rig-in-charge was erecting a pipe scaffold when he lost his footing and fell approximately 11 feet to a lower level. The fall resulted in traumatic injuries.
osha_narrative: An employee fell approximately 11 feet while erecting a pipe scaffold.

raw_text: Duliajan field Assam, worker slipped down the stairw and broke his ankle. Usne seedha seedha stairs par chalna tha, lekin usse slip ho gaya. He was carrying a pipe bundle when the fall occurred, and the supervisor had told him 'handrail use karo', par usne nahi maana. Fracture confirmed by on-site med.
osha_event_title: Other fall to lower level, unspecified
osha_narrative: An employee fell down the stairs and sustained a fractured ankle.

raw_text: Contract workman Amit was using a pressure washer to clean grease from a pump at the Ramgarh field when the wand slipped across his right foot. The high-pressure spray pierced his steel boot and caused lacerations and abrasions on the foot, so he was rushed to the clinic. Sab log kah rahe the, ye pressure washer bahut tej hai, dhyan se use karo.
osha_event_title: Struck by discharged object or substance
osha_narrative: An employee was using a pressure washer to wash grease off of equipment. The employee was moving the power washer wand from side to side, when the wand went across his right foot. The pressurized spray cut through his boot and caused abrasions and lacerations to his right foot. The employee was hospitalized.
